rules.label: No interaction for more than 3 minutes
rules.definition: Neither learner has taken a visible collaborative action for more than three minutes. Visible activity includes learner chat messages and measurement actions.
monitorSignals: No learner chat messages for more than three minutes.
No completed measurements for more than three minutes.

rules.label: Unbalanced participation
rules.definition: One learner carries most of the visible contribution while the other contributes little, mostly minimal acknowledgements, or few measurements.
monitorSignals: One learner contributes substantially more chat turns or measurements than the other.
The quieter learner mostly sends short acknowledgements or almost nothing.

rules.label: Shared uncertainty about the concept
rules.definition: The group demonstrates difficulty understanding or reasoning about the learning content because both learners are uncertain about the underlying concept.
monitorSignals: Both learners signal uncertainty, confusion, or not knowing about the same learning concept.

rules.label: Unresolved conceptual disagreement
rules.definition: Learners disagree about the learning content, interpretation, or reasoning, and the disagreement remains unresolved.
monitorSignals: Learners offer conflicting interpretations of the concept or evidence.

rules.label: Negative emotion or tension
rules.definition: Negative emotions interfere with productive collaboration, including frustration, anxiety, low confidence, tension, or giving up.

shouldFlagIf: At least one detection rule is clearly present in the recent conversation or measurement activity.
The pattern is likely to block productive learning, collaboration, or emotional regulation.
shouldNotFlagIf: The partners are already recovering on their own.
